title: 10 Years of DSPT: Roundtable + Celebration
description:
**Data Science Portugal (DSPT) is celebrating its 10th anniversary! 🎉**

DSPT is officially hitting double digits (watch out, teenage years are right around the corner!) and we are celebrating hard! 🎂

On **October 10th (10/10) in Porto,** join us for a **roundtable with the founders and early speakers of DSPT**, followed by an amazing **birthday party!**

We'll be looking to discuss just how Data Science and Artificial Intelligence has changed in Portugal over the past 10 years. We'll be hearing it direct from those who have already been in the field for a long time. Some nostalgia will certainly be in the mix!

**🗓️ Agenda**
• 18:30 — Check-in & welcome
• 19:00 — Roundtable: 10 Years of Data in Portugal
• 20:00 — Drinks, bites, and celebration time!
• 22:00 — Closing

**🎂 Full 10th Anniversary Program — Don't Forget to RSVP!**
October 10th is a full day of celebrations for DSPT! Each part of the day has its own separate Meetup page for capacity control:

1. Morning Session: Community & ecosystem track
2. Afternoon Workshop: Building Agentic AI: Essential Design Patterns & Challenge
3. Evening Party (This Event): The official DSPT 10-Year Anniversary Party - drinks, music, cake, and celebration!

👉 Important: To join the morning or afternoon sessions, make sure to RSVP individually for each event on Meetup so we can ensure proper headcount and logistics!

title: Building Agentic AI: Essential Design Patterns | Workshop + Challenge
description:
**Data Science Portugal (DSPT) is celebrating its 10th anniversary! 🎉**

DSPT is officially hitting double digits (watch out, teenage years are right around the corner!) and we are celebrating hard! 🎂

On **October 10th (10/10) in Porto,** we are taking over the afternoon for a special **hands-on session focused on Agentic AI,** essential **design patterns,** and **hands-on development with AI agents.**

This event is for developers, data scientists, and AI builders who want to stop treating LLMs merely as conversational chatbots and start building real autonomous systems that perceive, decide, and act through tools 💡

**🧠 What’s going to happen?**
Over the course of the afternoon, participants will:
• Take part in a deep-dive talk and workshop: **Building Agentic AI: Essential Design Patterns** led by **Ricardo Pereira** (U. Coimbra)
• Work in teams to tackle a **practical challenge**
• Use **GenAI tools** to speed up development and explore creative approaches
• **Pitch** their final solution in a short presentation
• **Vote** for the winning project 🎉
🏆 **The winning team will receive tickets to Porto Tech Hub 2026!**

**👥 Who is this event for?**
This workshop is geared toward practitioners and builders who want to look under the hood of autonomous agent architectures:
**• Intermediate Python knowledge is required**
• Curiosity and a willingness to build and experiment with autonomous workflows are essential 💪

You can:
• Sign up with friends in **teams of 3–4 people**, or
• **Join on your own**, and we’ll help you form a team on the day.

**🗓️ Agenda**
• 14:00 — Check-in & welcome
• 14:30 — Talk: Building Agentinc AI - Essential Design Patterns by Ricardo Pereira
• 15:30 — Team development session
• 17:00 — Project pitches
• 18:00 — Public voting & winner reveal

**💻 What to bring**
• Your laptop and charger
• Python 3.10+ installed and ready

**📌 Spots are limited -** Secure your seat, come build the future of autonomous AI with us, and celebrate 10 years of DSPT! 🚀

title: Keeping Communities Alive: A Roundtable for Community Organizers
description:
**Data Science Portugal (DSPT) is celebrating its 10th anniversary! 🎉**

DSPT is officially hitting double digits (watch out, teenage years are right around the corner!) and we are celebrating hard! 🎂

On **October 10th (10/10) in Porto,** we are starting our morning with a special **roundtable of AI + tech communities.**

Starting a community is the easy part. Keeping it alive is harder. We're bringing together community organizers for an open roundtable about what happens behind the scenes: finding sponsors, keeping volunteers motivated, avoiding burnout, understanding what members actually want, and growing beyond your home city. This isn't a series of talks. It's a conversation. Come ready to share what has worked for you, what hasn't, and what you're still trying to figure out. Whether you've organized dozens of events or are thinking about starting your first community, there's a seat at the table for you.
